section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1983
title: 5 Among the Metropolitan Cities, the highest volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population was registered in Pune (110·22) followed by Delhi (65·29), Bombay (52·23), Bangalore (45·65) and Nagpur (44·85). The remaining Metropolitan cities registered the volume of accidental deaths less than (40·00), the lowest being registered in Kanpur (18·42). The details are presented in Table II.
